memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, walks 2 km daily, manages pharmacy duties without assistance.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5, no difficulty recalling items or drawing clock.
falls: No falls in the last 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: 9 regular (amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD, escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD, atorvastatin 10 mg HS, rosuvastatin 10 mg OD, fenofibrate 145 mg OD); polypharmacy – request review against Beers criteria.
mood: Denies low mood, reports occasional worry related to work; GAD-7 score 8 (mild anxiety).
carers: Spouse, Priya – provides support with medication reminders.
goals: "I want to stay active and keep my blood pressure under control without side effects."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports occasional knee discomfort after standing; still manages pharmacy duties.
cognition: Mini-Cog not due yet.
falls: One fall in last 12 months (tripped over rug, no injury); gait unsteady on uneven surface; timed up-and-go 13 seconds (≥12) – raised fall risk. Plan: home‑based strength exercises, non‑slip footwear, vitamin D 800 IU daily.
medicines: 9 regular; polypharmacy – Beers review scheduled.
mood: GAD-7 9 (mild); denies low mood.
carers: Spouse, Priya – helps with home exercise setup.
goals: "I want to stay steady on my feet and avoid another fall."

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been feeling more nervous lately, especially when the pharmacy gets busy. My heart races and I worry I’ll make a mistake. I’ve tried deep breathing but it doesn’t help enough.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Physiotherapy Department, Sri Jayadeva Institute of Cardiovascular Sciences, for falls prevention programme. Include recent TUG results and fall history.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Physiotherapy feedback: Patient attended 6 sessions; gait improved, TUG now 11 seconds. Home exercise plan provided. Advised to continue non‑slip footwear and vitamin D supplementation.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs; walks 1.5 km daily without fatigue.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 2/5 (≤2) – positive screen. Plan: formal neuropsychological assessment scheduled.
falls: No falls in past year; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: 9 regular; polypharmacy – Beers review completed, no potentially inappropriate meds identified.
mood: GAD-7 7 (mild); denies depression.
carers: Spouse, Priya – assists with medication reminders.
goals: "I want to keep my mind sharp and remain active for my family."
